_comment: STAGE CONTRACTS. One spec per v12 stage. READMEs are GENERATED from this file - never hand-edited. Change the contract here, regenerate, and every domain updates.

00_inbox_working.question: I am thinking about this
00_inbox_working.completion: Material can be expressed as an initial story or candidate claim.
00_inbox_working.propagation: none - raw nodes are orphans until classified
00_inbox_working.nlp: Language ID, dedupe by hash, rough domain guess against _DOMAIN.md cards. Never assert a domain from here.
00_inbox_working.validation: Originals preserved. Nothing here is canonical. No claimID may be issued.

01_middle_seed.question: Here is what we found and why it might matter
01_middle_seed.completion: At least one material claim has been extracted into 02_claim_atoms.
01_middle_seed.propagation: none - a seed carries no falsification weight
01_middle_seed.nlp: Extract candidate claims. Propose domain + tags + glyph signature. Flag sentences that assert without support.
01_middle_seed.validation: Written for an informed adult. Must state what is uncertain. May not present the formal case as complete.
01_middle_seed.rendering: Optional preview. Mark clearly as unreviewed.

02_claim_atoms.question: What exactly is being claimed?
02_claim_atoms.completion: Atom validates clean and carries both canonical expressions.
02_claim_atoms.propagation: SOURCE OF TRUTH. Falsification originates and propagates from here per bridgeGrade.
02_claim_atoms.nlp: Emit mathFormNormal. Propose candidate bridges (ungraded, propagates=false). Never assign a grade.
02_claim_atoms.validation: python _scripts/validate_atoms.py must return 0 errors. Only claim nodes carry claimID.
02_claim_atoms.rendering: The atom renders BOTH canon folders. Neither is hand-authored.
